design_gotchas.title: High 250 °C/W SOT-23-5 θJA Caps Continuous Power at 400 mW (25°C) — Derate From 5 V
design_gotchas.detail: Page 4 specifies θJA = 250 °C/W for SOT-23-5 and Page 13 calculates PD(MAX) = 0.4 W at TA = 25°C (TJ <= 125°C). Dropping 5.0 V to 3.3 V at full 300 mA dissipates 0.51 W — driving TJ to 152.5°C even at room temperature! Limit continuous load from 5 V to <= 235 mA at 25°C (<= 94 mA at 85°C), or supply from a 3.7–4.2 V Li-Ion/buck rail.

design_gotchas.title: Overline 'Shutdown' Pin Trap (Active-High Enable) & VCE <= VIN + 0.3 V Sequencing
design_gotchas.detail: Plain-text extraction drops the overbar on Pin 3 (overline Shutdown on p.1 & p.3), which actually means active-low shutdown / active-high enable (VIH >= 1.5 V ON, VIL <= 0.5 V OFF, 3 MOhm internal pulldown, 60 Ohm auto-discharge). Page 4 also restricts VCE abs max to -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V — do not drive Pin 3 high before VIN ramps up, and check 1.5 V VIH margin with 1.8 V logic.

design_gotchas.title: 50 mA Short-Circuit Limit & Page 11 ESR Plot vs Low-ESR MLCC Text Discrepancy
design_gotchas.detail: Short-circuit current folds back to ~50 mA (p.5, p.13), which can prevent startup into pre-biased or heavy constant-current loads. Additionally, while Pages 1 and 12 explicitly claim low-ESR 1 uF X7R/X5R ceramic stability, the Page 11 ESR stability plots draw a black 'Min' line at ~0.25 Ohm (1 uF) and 0.1 Ohm (4.7 uF) — validate load-transient phase margin on bench when using ultra-low-ESR MLCCs.

design_gotchas.title: 85°C Ambient Ceiling & Pin 4 NC Compatibility Against BYP/NR-Pin SOT-23-5 LDOs
design_gotchas.detail: Operating ambient range is -40°C to +85°C (p.4, p.14), narrower than +125°C TJ TI equivalents like TLV702 or TPS7A20. Pin 4 is NC on AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (ADJ only on AP2127K-ADJTRG1), so an existing bypass cap on a legacy BYP/NR footprint is harmless, though verify Pin 4 is not routed to a feedback divider.

typical_use_cases: 5 V-to-3.3 V or Li-Ion-to-3.3 V datacom, motherboard, and notebook sub-rails up to 300 mA (thermally derated)
Cost-optimized general-purpose 3.3 V CMOS LDO needing fast 50 us soft-start and 60 Ohm active output discharge
Audio, codec, and analog sensor bias rails leveraging 68 dB PSRR (100 Hz/1 kHz) and 60 uVRMS noise
Candidate second-source for Pin-4-NC SOT-23-5 footprints (AP2112K, TLV702, TLV733P) when <= 300 mA and <= 85°C TA
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP2127K-3.3TRG1 is a 300 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2% at 25°C) high-speed CMOS LDO in a 5-pin SOT-23-5 ('K') package (1=VIN, 2=GND, 3=overline-Shutdown [active-high EN with 3 MOhm pulldown], 4=NC, 5=VOUT with 60 Ohm auto-discharge). Operating from 2.5 V to 6.0 V (6.5 V abs max, -40°C to +85°C TA), it features 170 mV typical / 300 mV max dropout at 300 mA, 60 uA IQ, 0.1 uA standby current, 68 dB PSRR (1 kHz), 60 uVRMS noise, 50 us soft-start, and 1 uF MLCC compatibility. Designers must derate load current thermally (θJA = 250 °C/W, PD(MAX) = 400 mW at 25°C), keep VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V, and check bench transient ringing against the Page 11 ESR plot.
